fusions.name: Upthrust Reef
fusions.desc: Jagged reef-stone erupts around you, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaving each [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on them spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Staghorn Spur
fusions.desc: A jab with a spur of reef-stone that deals 8 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds. You hold 4 spurs; each kill grows one back.

fusions.name: Tidepool Growth
fusions.desc: A low reef grows where you stand. For 8 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and every ally within 3 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Accreting Shell
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 8%, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.
